agentCapability.claude: Claude Code supports native lifecycle hooks in settings.json, including prompt, tool, permission, notification, and stop events.
agentCapability.codex: Codex supports lifecycle hooks through hooks.json or config.toml layers. Termflow installs status hooks in the user hooks.json.
agentCapability.antigravity: Antigravity CLI uses native top-level groups in hooks.json. Termflow maps PreInvocation and Stop to running, completion, and error states; the current API has no standalone permission-wait event.
agentCapability.opencode: OpenCode uses plugin event hooks rather than JSON hook entries. Termflow manages a status plugin in the OpenCode plugins directory.
agentCapability.qoder: Qoder CLI uses native lifecycle hooks in settings.json. Termflow maps prompt, tool, permission and elicitation, stop, and failure events into canonical session states.

about.localControlDesc: Projects and runtime data remain under your control, while Skills, Hooks, and MCP become reusable workflows.
about.description: Termflow is not another agent. It is a shared desktop workspace for the local AI coding agents you already use. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity CLI, OpenCode, and Qoder CLI can work within one flow—from projects and sessions to an embedded terminal, Skills, Hooks, and MCP—so you can preserve context, switch collaborators, and keep complex work moving.

searchIndex.title: Search Index
searchIndex.subtitle: Manage local repository indexing and instant search
searchIndex.autoIndexDescription: Automatically index new folders containing fewer than 50,000 files.
searchIndex.instantSearchDescription: Allow a local index for the current repository. Fast scan is used automatically until the index is ready. All data stays on this device.
searchIndex.preflightDescription: Discovering indexable files with repository ignore rules. Search continues to use fast scan during this phase.
searchIndex.buildingDescription: Writing text to the local FTS5 index. An incomplete temporary index is never used for search.
searchIndex.pausedDescription: Index building is paused. Search continues to use the fast scan.
searchIndex.updatingDescription: Applying changed files to the local FTS5 index in a batch. Search safely uses fast scan while the update is in progress.
searchIndex.readyDescription: The FTS5 index is ready. Plain text queries use it to select candidates and then verify exact matches; short and regex queries automatically use fast scan.
searchIndex.staleDescription: Repository changes were detected and the index is waiting for an automatic rebuild. Search safely falls back to fast scan meanwhile.
searchIndex.failedDescription: Index construction failed and search safely fell back to fast scan: {{error}}
searchIndex.unsupportedDescription: The current SQLite runtime does not support the required FTS5 trigram tokenizer. Search continues to use fast scan.
searchIndex.pauseFailed: Unable to update the index pause state: {{error}}
searchIndex.loadFailed: Unable to load search index settings: {{error}}
searchIndex.eventFailed: Unable to listen for search index status: {{error}}
searchIndex.saveFailed: Unable to save search index settings: {{error}}
searchIndex.enabledSuccess: Index construction started for this repository; fast scan remains active during the build
searchIndex.disabledSuccess: Indexing is disabled for this repository
searchIndex.skippedNonTextFiles: Skipped {{count}} binary, non-text, or oversized files
searchIndex.excludedDirectories: Dependency and build directories (such as node_modules, target, and dist) are excluded by rule and are not candidate files.
searchIndex.deleteConfirmDescription: This deletes the current project's local search index and disables indexing for it. You can enable and rebuild it later.
searchIndex.deleteFailed: Unable to delete the project index: {{error}}
searchIndex.rebuildFailed: Unable to rebuild the search index: {{error}}
searchIndex.storageLimitDescription: Using {{used}} across {{projects}} project indexes. Older unused indexes are removed first when the limit is exceeded.
searchIndex.storageLoadFailed: Unable to load index storage settings: {{error}}
searchIndex.storageSaveFailed: Unable to save index storage settings: {{error}}
searchIndex.clearCacheDescription: Deletes every local search index. Open projects rebuild their index automatically when needed.
searchIndex.clearCacheConfirmDescription: This deletes local search indexes only. Your repositories and settings are not affected.

usageData.title: Data & Privacy
usageData.subtitle: Manage de-identified agent usage data stored on this device. Archiving or deleting source tasks does not remove retained statistics.
usageData.loadFailed: Unable to load usage data status
usageData.storageDescription: Successfully parsed Codex logs are stored in Termflow SQLite and remain available after source logs are deleted.
usageData.included: Only model, date, token, message/session counts, and sync metadata are stored. Session identifiers are hashed with a per-install random salt.
usageData.excluded: Prompts, responses, tool content, project paths, file names, raw session IDs, account data, and API keys are never stored.
usageData.rebuildDescription: Rebuild deletes snapshots and rescans logs that still exist while preserving the last manual-clear cutoff.
usageData.clearDescription: Clear deletes retained statistics and creates a cutoff at the current time, so older logs are not imported again.
usageData.clearConfirmContent: Termflow cannot restore this data. Existing logs before the cutoff will not be imported again; only new usage will be counted.
